name: trench-differential-equations-site
description: Eleventy build of Trench's Elementary Differential Equations with Boundary Value Problems (LaTeX source rendered to HTML)

scripts.update:vendor: npm run update:mathjax && npm run update:minisearch
scripts.update:mathjax: rm -rf assets/js/mathjax && mkdir -p assets/js/mathjax/fonts/mathjax-newcm-font && cp node_modules/mathjax/tex-chtml.js assets/js/mathjax/ && cp -r node_modules/mathjax/ui node_modules/mathjax/a11y node_modules/mathjax/sre assets/js/mathjax/ && cp node_modules/@mathjax/mathjax-newcm-font/chtml.js assets/js/mathjax/fonts/mathjax-newcm-font/ && cp -r node_modules/@mathjax/mathjax-newcm-font/chtml assets/js/mathjax/fonts/mathjax-newcm-font/
scripts.update:minisearch: rm -rf assets/js/vendor && mkdir -p assets/js/vendor && cp node_modules/minisearch/dist/es/index.js assets/js/vendor/minisearch.js
